name: Where Am I? 🗺️ [Alpha]
desc:
🎮 How to Play > Look around and Guess Your Location on the Map!

Welcome to Where am I? The Ultimate Geography Game on Roblox!

Think you know the world? Prove it! Use visual clues to pinpoint where you are, and compete against others for the highest accuracy!

💬 Give us Feedback so we can improve the game!
👍 Like & Favourite the game for Updates!

🌍 Explore all kinds of Locations across the Globe!
🔍 Use clues like Signs, Nature and Architecture to Guess where you are!
🥊 Compete against your friends and prove you're the ultimate world detective!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and prove your Geo-skills!

🏞️ Current Locations in Game: 600+
